newsitem.title: USA: Equity Residential files $750 mln shelf.
newsitem.headline: Equity Residential files $750 mln shelf.

text.p: Equity Residential Properties Trust said Monday it filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission for up to $750 million in preferred shares, common shares and depositary shares.
When combined with previously registered offerings the company said it will have up to $1.026 billion in those securities available for sale.
The Chicago-based real estate investment trust said it will contribute or otherwise transfer net proceeds from the offering to its operating partnership.
The partnership, in turn, will use the funds for general business purposes, including repayment of debt and acquisitions of multi-family residential properties.
